name: LeadCanvas
tagline: LeadCanvas is a sales intelligence platform that uses AI and real-time Google Maps data to extract contact information from local businesses
description: LeadCanvas is a sales intelligence platform that uses AI and real-time Google Maps data to extract contact information from local businesses. It retrieves phone numbers, email addresses, WhatsApp contacts, and social media profiles, with WhatsApp verification ensuring active contacts before outreach.
